python-engineer.description: Implements small, well-tested Python changes using uv, ruff, and pytest.

check.description: Run format, lint, tests, and build checks
check.prompt: Run the project checks and report failures clearly: `uv run ruff format --check`, `uv run ruff check`, `uv run pytest`, and `uv build`.
